observations: The WP510 G1 contract correctly requires causal status to be re-evaluated from declared intervention/control arms rather than trusted from a downstream label.

WP507 CausalInfluenceResult is directly constructible: its __post_init__ validates identifiers, digests and the finite status alphabet, but it carries no factory seal comparable to CellUptakeReceipt, UptakeSummary or CausalProbeArm. The canonical derived status is instead computed by evaluate_causal_influence().

Therefore a future WP510 API must not accept a caller-supplied CausalInfluenceResult or its digest as causal authority. A structurally valid object can carry CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED_AT_CONTRACT_SCOPE even when the bound intervention/control arms would deterministically evaluate to UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL, UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_UPTAKE or NO_CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED.

WP510 should reconstruct the UptakeSummary from concrete factory-sealed source receipts, re-run evaluate_causal_influence from concrete factory-sealed CausalProbeArm values and the exact BroadcastEnvelope, and compare/reuse only that rebuilt result. Re-entry bindings must likewise be validated through validate_reentry_uptake_binding rather than trusted by serialized fields or digests alone.

At observation time src/frankenstein2/gwt_causal_path.py was not yet present on canonical main, so this review records a pre-implementation falsifier contract and does not claim an implementation defect already exists.
counterhypothesis: If WP510 never accepts a CausalInfluenceResult as an input and always computes the result internally from exact WP507 builders plus source evidence, the forged-result path is unreachable by construction. In that case the proposed regression should pass as a contract-preservation test rather than force a source change.
cheapest_discriminator: Construct a syntactically valid CausalInfluenceResult with copied broadcast/summary/arm identities and digests but a deliberately false-positive status while the concrete bound arms deterministically evaluate to NO_CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED or UNKNOWN. The WP510 seal API must either have no parameter/path by which that object can influence output, or must reject/ignore it and emit the status recomputed by evaluate_causal_influence. Pair with one forged serialized re-entry binding whose digest fields match but whose factory lineage is absent; validate_reentry_uptake_binding must fail it.
next_exact_action: The active WP510 mutation authority should encode the forged-causal-result discriminator as a fail-closed regression before terminal component-CI acceptance, while continuing to rebuild summary/result/bindings from exact canonical builders and preserving UNKNOWN/NO_CAUSAL states.
